conventions.run: scripts/model_calls.py turns this file into a batch file ({ calls, rollback: false, stopOnError: false }): rollback false because the list runs past its refusals and uses history_undo, history_redo and history_restore, which a batch that rolls back refuses whole. batch { file, budget: 100 }; from: next goes on.
conventions.references: { "$from": n, "$at": "key" } takes a value from call n's answer (n: the index in this whole list; agentlink/chain.py). Used for: the checkpoint's id (24 -> 29), the note's id (114 -> the four note calls up to 121), the unwrap's SVG path (147 -> td_view_more symbol 148 and draft_outline 149, 151, 152), a window picture's path (154 -> td_view_more image 155). No reference reaches more than 7 calls back. The list is long (200 calls; a batch starts calls for 55 s, 100 at most with budget) and is answered in parts, and a part refuses a reference into an earlier part (invalid_state: "its answer is not kept between parts"): when next lands between a source and its reader, start the part at the source instead — batch { file, from: <the source's index> } runs it again (the sources here are a checkpoint, a note, an SVG and a picture: a second one harms nothing) — or send the reader by hand with the value the source answered.
conventions.refused: An expect starting REFUSED means isError with that code; one that names a state in capitals first (BEFORE ANY SOLVE: REFUSED …, ON FREECAD 1.1.3: REFUSED …, INSIDE A BATCH: REFUSED …) or gives two cases means the refusal in that state; the words after it are the refusal's own, from the tool's entry or the hub's code. "…" stands for words left out.
conventions.window: Every call goes to the window's link (session_state where: window). Nothing here takes the cursor, focus or full screen: window_snapshot is drawn by Qt in the background, cmd_run and menu_run press view commands only.
conventions.batch: batch is the carrier: every row of the run's answer (results[n]: tool, ok, result or error) is batch's proof, with ran, record (batches/<date>-<time>.json), and notRun / next when the budget ends a part. Its own refusals cannot be calls of this list (a batch holding a batch is refused whole): they are in runAlone.
conventions.leftBehind: The document UnprovenHub stays open and unsaved. Files in the session's folder: unproven_steps/ (3 PNG), unproven_window.png, unproven_report.png, unproven_render.png, unproven_snap.png, unproven_stress.png, unproven_foot_top.svg, unproven_cap.dxf, unproven-cantilever.vtu / .csv, Beam-stress.csv, one checkpoint copy (and a second if history_restore went by file). Settings: none (Mod/AgentLink/LiveTest/Probe is set and removed).

runAlone.about: Moved to files of their own in models/alone (one per group, each with why it cannot be a call of this list), so that this list runs unattended as one batch { file }. Run them after this list, in the order of their names; the ones marked restarts last of all, one at a time, with the person's go.

notCovered: app_restart, app_force_restart, app_install: they quit FreeCAD or download and install a release. A safe proof needs the person's go, saved documents and a FreeCAD they can lose a session of: app_restart alone on an empty document, then session_state for the same document list; app_force_restart only on a window made stuck on purpose (a modal dialog opened by hand); app_install only with a version they name.

pref_import: it writes a whole settings file over the person's. A safe proof: export the present settings first, import a file holding only Mod/AgentLink/LiveTest/Probe, pref_get it, then import the export back — with the person's go, since a wrong file changes their FreeCAD.

pref_pack { apply }: there is no un-apply. A safe proof needs a settings history to take it back (pref_history / pref_rollback of the add-on that keeps one) and the person's go; the list above proves the listing and the refusal of a wrong name only.

addon install / update / remove: code FreeCAD runs, confirmed by words the person types. A safe proof: the person types confirm for a tiny add-on they do not use, install, addon list shows it, remove with their confirm, list again. The list above runs list and search only; the refusal for a missing confirm (not_allowed, "Nothing was changed") is not called either, by the brief.
app_extensions add / remove / sync: the person's list of repositories (code fetched and run). Only list and the refusal for a missing repo are called.
collab: it shares work with other agents and people (its own private add-on); a proof needs a second party and the person's say.

gui_input: real mouse and keyboard input into the window; coredoc-gui-model.json holds its steps. A safe proof is that script on the reset document, in the background, with the person not typing in FreeCAD at that moment.

live_run: it runs whole scripts of calls, changes among them, and its reset rebuilds the WindowTest document. A safe proof: live_run { script: "reset" } then live_run { script: "agentlink", budget: 60 } in a session with no document of the person's in front.

cmd_run's and menu_run's refusal of what they will not run (Std_Quit, Std_DlgMacroExecute, Std_Open …): not called. If the refusal failed the command would run — quit FreeCAD or open a modal dialog. cmd_list { query: "Std_Quit" } shows the refused mark instead; a safe proof of the refusal itself is cmd_run { name: "Std_About" } (the worst case is an About box, which gui_unstick closes) run alone, not in a batch.
outputs_clean { dry_run: false }: it moves files to the Trash. Dry run only, by the brief.

dialog_answer and gui_unstick with a dialog up: the list reads the no-dialog answers only. A proof with one up needs a dialog opened on purpose (gui_input, or the person), then dialog_answer {} to read it and { button: "Cancel" }; gui_unstick the same with a menu left open.
snapshot_latest with a picture: only the person takes screenshots (the camera button, Alt+Shift+S). With none the refusal is the proof; the picture path needs them to take one.
queue_go with a job held: the hold is set only while the person works in the window and a heavy job waits. The list proves the answer with nothing held.
asm_rigid_group's success: FreeCAD 1.2 and newer only; on 1.1.3 the unavailable refusal is all there is.
scad_code's success: needs the OpenSCAD program, which the person installs; without it the refusal is what runs.
td_view_more kinds broken (with real break marks) and draft (a Draft object): not called; lock, stack, clip, clip_add, clip_remove, symbol, image, share and move are.
history_checkpoint / history_restore across a restart (how: file) and history_diff against a checkpoint older than the session: the restart is not made here.
fea_solve { nonlinear } and the solve on Agent Link's own deck: the FEM model (sheetfem-fem-model.json) has the own-deck solve after fea_refine; this list solves once, linear, by FreeCAD's FEM route.
usage_report's refusal (AGENTLINK_USAGE=off) and report_read / view_snapshot headless (unavailable): states of the installation, not of a call.
